_comment: LoRA data table (2026-09-30 owner model). One entry per known LoRA. Fields: `id`; `owner` ('model' template-private / 'Plugin' plugin-owned / 'none' public manager; absent = none); `path` = the unified-dir relative name used to LOAD (resolved as <comfy_root>/models/loras/<path>); `source` = the origin absolute path COPIED into the unified dir; `default_strength_*`; `description`. Templates and plugins reference the relative name / id; only `source` ever points outside the unified dir.
